output_dir: docs/.vitepress/dist/ (default outDir .vitepress/dist relative to srcDir; here srcDir is docs/)
file_to_url:
strip output_dir prefix; index.html -> /; any other

.html -> /

.html (or /

with cleanUrls: true; default cleanUrls is false so .html is kept)
second_source_of_truth: hand count of starter source pages (3 .md files: index.md, markdown-examples.md, api-examples.md); the build log prints no page count
gotchas: VitePress emits <name>.html (file style), not <name>/index.html: nested page guide/intro.md becomes guide/intro.html. A **/index.html-only rule counts the 3-page starter as 1 route instead of 3.
404.html sits at the dist root alongside real pages and must be explicitly excluded.
Each page ships a hashed per-page JS chunk in assets/ (e.g. assets/api-examples.md.<hash>.js) plus a .lean.js twin; assets/** must be excluded or any naive file-based count explodes.
hashmap.json (page data manifest) and vp-icons.css are metadata, not pages.
The build log prints no page count ('rendering pages...' only), so verification required a hand count of source pages; no sitemap is emitted by default.
